summary: Default conversation sync to public and private channels, and report verifier-mode canvas mutations as no-ops even when output fields are filtered.
reason: A default request for DM and group-DM scopes can fail for a bot token and skip useful channel mirroring. A synthetic verifier response must not be presented as a completed canvas write.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests check the channel-type default, other-resource isolation, and verifier no-op reporting for canvas writes. Request-level sync tests confirm explicit --param and --resource-param values override the default. Canvas command tests confirm --select and --compact preserve success=false and verify_noop=true after filtering. The full module test suite, go vet, and go build pass without provider HTTP.
